newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea says would not go to war over food crisis.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea says would not go to war over food crisis.

text.p: Famine-threatened North Korea said on Thursday it would not go to war to resolve the food crisis in the communist nation.
"War is not what we want," said a spokesman for North Korea's Foreign Ministry in a report carried by the official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA).
In the statement, the North Korean spokesman said the food crisis caused by two consecutive years of flooding was reaching a "serious stage".
"It is true that our temporary food shortage has reached a serious stage," he said.
International aid agencies have warned that tens of thousands of people could starve to death over the next few months unless substantial food aid is sent to North Korea.

"We have frankly informed the international community of our temporary food crisis and requested it to render assistance to us," the spokesman said. "Moreover, we have mobilised even servicemen in doing farming to surmount the difficulties with our own efforts."
